relations: A car tire hovers just above the rightmost sealed muffin package on gravel.
If the tire descends onto the package, the plastic and cake compress under its tread.
The left packages remain untouched unless the tire shifts laterally across the row.
Gravel contact keeps each package resting flat until pressed.
